About Us
Venn Healthcare supply advanced, non-invasive systems for medical, cosmetic and aesthetic markets. Our product portfolio includes carefully selected treatments from trusted global brands Product lines include a wide range of devices with various applications from dermatological applications such as HIFU, Fat Freezing, skin tightening, laser tattoo and hair removal to the treatment of soft tissue injuries and urological pathologies. Technologies vary from the latest fat freezing and laser machines to shockwave therapy devices and micro needling. 

Clients include clinicians and physiotherapists to clinic owners and hospital managers, this give us a deeper understanding of both client and practitioner needs. www.vennhealthcare.com
